name: where-to-watch-the-90s
description: Find where any 90s or 2000s movie or TV show is streaming right now. A living replacement for the static streaming-guide PDF.

scripts.check: node --check dev-server.js && for f in api/*.js api/_lib/*.js public/app.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'all files OK'
